findings.summary: Verified: the canonical adopter-policy invariant_producers block is byte-identical to the generated .devai/config/invariant-producers.json. The policy 1.4.0 binding digests match the actual files for adopter-policy, domains, invariant-producers, project, thresholds and scorecard-na, and thresholds/NA are unchanged. All nine producers bind to test-tasks with the same population, and their requiredTestIds are subsets of each task's: RBAC 10 of 736 (7 guard + 729 policy, overlap with DASH declared) and errors 13 of 13, all matching the real spec titles. INV-AUTH/DATA/SEC-001 stay unbound and untouched.

Verified: the only permitted transitions are the two literal appends, R-0037 (PR #207) and R-0025 (PR #205). Current bytes of both streams match the approved sha256 values. The baseline 92be0db and commits 173ab167 and 2e04f29c are all ancestors of HEAD, and the foundation job now uses fetch-depth 0. The 14 missing rounds (R-0001, R-0020 to R-0032) remain named gaps. record/ and .devai/state are unchanged from main. The test fixture resolves the git dir with rev-parse --absolute-git-dir and only reads from it.
